notes.title: Added translation in multiple languages
notes.notes:
Aim Camp has also been translated into Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Turkish.
Let us know if there are any translation errors.
Thank you for playing and contributing to the development of Aim Camp.

notes.title: Interface Translation
notes.notes:
We have updated the game by translating the interface into the following languages: German, French, Italian, and Spanish.

Soon, we will also translate it into other languages to allow players from all over the world to navigate the menu more easily.

Stay tuned for upcoming upgrades.

notes.title: Aim Camp has been released, but development continues.
notes.notes:
The development of Aim Camp continues. We are working on expanding the map and introducing a new 'missions' mode where players will need to follow waypoints and complete tasks, eliminating enemies and targets with maximum precision along the way.

With this mode, we will also introduce 'lean' and 'jump' movements to adapt the character's mobility to the new tasks required.

There is much more we have planned, and we will keep you updated as development progresses.

notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes:
Aim Camp is coming out of Early Access and becoming a full game. We've implemented the PvE training mode, where enemies now return fire in specific exercises, increasing the challenge level and progression of the training.

We've also added character equipment customization, allowing players to adjust it to their personal preferences.

Our goal is to offer a complete and fun aim training experience.

notes.title: Aim Camp has been released!!!
notes.notes:
We have put a lot of work into this title, driven by passion and personal challenge. 
We hope the Steam community will enjoy it, as we poured all our passion into making it the best it can be. 
We're looking forward to players' feedback to improve it and make it even better. 
See you at the Camp!!!
